SIERRA AND CHELSEA WALTON，与 lit:000000 逐字对齐。PDF 276168 B，sha256 1b187667323379f530a5b71fbf7f450f6fdb469f17e36f485810d61f028a0535；纯文字稿 library/sierra-walton-witt-enveloping-algebra-not-noetherian-arxiv-1304-0114.txt（sha256 8019567c89ecbb4b0bf8ba941ea31030408390428a3bcea3bf40bc97391399cb），已挂到 lit:000000.path 与 download（status=ok）。原文在 PDF 第 1 页（arXiv v3 页标记）：
- 「We are motivated by the well-known question of whether it is possible for the universal enveloping algebra of an infinite dimensional Lie algebra to be noetherian (cf. [GW04, page xix]). It is generally thought that the answer to this question should be "no," and we state this as a conjecture:」随即 **Conjecture 0.1.**「A Lie algebra L is finite dimensional if and only if the universal enveloping algebra U(L) is noetherian.」
- **Question 0.3.**「(C. Dean and L. Small, 1990) Is U(W) noetherian?」
